claims: Transfuse packed red blood cells for severe anemia (hemoglobin 7.2 g/dL).
Continue mechanical ventilation with lung-protective settings, currently CPAP/PSV with PEEP 5 cmH2O and FiO2 40%, and monitor respiratory status.
Monitor arterial blood gases to assess oxygenation and ventilation, given recent pH 7.38, pCO2 42 mm Hg, and pO2 239 mm Hg on FiO2 60%.
Replete calcium with intravenous calcium gluconate for hypocalcemia (total calcium 7.2 mg/dL, ionized calcium 1.0 mmol/L).
Replete magnesium with intravenous magnesium sulfate for hypomagnesemia (magnesium 1.7 mg/dL).
Monitor serum electrolytes, including potassium, magnesium, and calcium, given ongoing supplementation and critical illness.
Monitor hemoglobin and hematocrit to assess response to transfusion and ongoing anemia.
Continue enteral feeding or nutrition support, as indicated, given inadequate nutrition per Braden scale and critical illness.
Assess and manage sedation, targeting Richmond-RAS -1 to -2, with current moderate sedation (RASS -3) on propofol and fentanyl.
Perform chest imaging (e.g., chest X-ray) to evaluate pulmonary status and endotracheal tube position, given mechanical ventilation and recent ETT position change.
